The isolated [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexus]] of [[Thule/Legends|Thule]] played host to a '''[[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Special forces/Legends|stealth]] [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]]''' of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|old Sith Empire]]<ref name="GatORW" /> during the [[Manderon Period]].<ref name="TNEC" /> One of the few vestigial communities of Sith to survive the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]<ref name="GatORW" /> and subsequent [[Post–Great Hyperspace War counterinvasion|counterinvasion]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref><ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref><ref name="SWTORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref><ref name="Timeline12">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 12: The Great Hyperspace War|int=Timeline 12: The Great Hyperspace War}}</ref> this group remained in seclusion on Thule for centuries in preparation for the eventual return of the Sith to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
Sometime prior to [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Special forces/Legends|stealth]] [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]] of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|old Sith Empire]] settled the secluded [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexus]] of [[Thule/Legends|Thule]].<ref name="GatORW" /> This [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] unit was drawn to Thule both for its isolated location on the westernmost edges of the [[Stygian Caldera]]<ref name="TEA" /> and for its natural concerted power in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="GatORW" />

Following the Sith Empire's defeat in the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], a small number of Sith refugees<ref name="TEA" /> and loyalists<ref name="GatORW" /> fled to Thule in an effort to escape the [[post–Great Hyperspace War counterinvasion]], a joint [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]]-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] invasion of the Sith Empire<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="TEGtW" /> aimed at eliminating any vestigial threat it posed to the safety of the Republic.<ref name="SWTORE" /><ref name="Timeline12" /><ref name="Timeline11">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 11: Rebirth of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 11: Rebirth of the Sith Empire}}</ref> Confident that the Empire's defeat at the hands of the Republic would be temporary, the regiment remained in seclusion on Thule, bolstering its ranks with Sith loyalists and training in preparation to serve as an advance force for a resurgent Sith Empire.<ref name="GatORW" />

The group persisted through the passage of the centuries, maintaining ties with other vestigial groups of Sith loyalists who had similarly survived the collapse of the old Sith Empire. Though their numbers sank significantly in the years that followed, the descendants of the original group continued to pledge themselves to the service of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] even into the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]].<ref name="GatORW" />
